game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake, a lake of glacier melt: the summit pilot must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the basecamp tent.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake: a lake of glacier melt
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Lake, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the basecamp tent. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the lock_letters value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the basecamp tent using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The basecamp tent reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the basecamp tent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Letter Lock' (Week 8 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Glacier Lake'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_letters changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Lake.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The basecamp tent reached with actions_used <= 18.
